spans.text: We're kicking off a series of weekly analyses here, consolidating the events and moves of the last few days into a more straight-to-the-point post.
Bitcoin closed the week down, but with a very interesting move that we'll break down below:
The 100-Week EMA

This past week marked the first rejection at the 100-week EMA. For those who have been following us for a while, you know we had already talked about this retest of the 100W EMA ever since it was lost in January.
Whenever an EMA like this is lost, it has a strong tendency to act as resistance, and that's exactly what happened.
This region also lines up with a price zone that showed buying volume in November of last year, and heavy selling volume at the start of this year.
The Weekly Low

The interesting part of the weekly move was the bottom formation at $74k: first, it happened over the weekend, liquidating some of the players and creating a strong expectation of a breakout above the EMA.

The reason for the drop is very simple: rumors involving the U.S. deal with Iran. A rumor of a new American strike was enough to spark panic. But that sentiment didn't last long: Trump spoke about the deal and price quickly reclaimed $77k.
With that, the bottom formation became very interesting, representing a liquidity sweep below the April low.
What Now?
This is
still a Bear Market
and both the 100W and 50W EMAs act as resistance. In other words, the odds still favor difficulty in reclaiming $85k and $90k.
The market read, via Polymarket, agrees with this: the majority of bets are on BTC targeting $70k before $90k.
However, pessimism isn't taking over: we have the 200W EMA as imminent support and, week by week, we're advancing in the cycle and reducing the odds of a major leg down.
The cycle bottom range currently sits between ~$60k and $44k, but both values keep rising.
The chance that the bottom was already made on February 6 is also rising
With that, for anyone who isn't positioned in the market,
starting to scale into positions from the current price down to the $40k range is an excellent idea
. We don't know how far it will fall or if it will fall further, so
don't try to catch the bottom.
